From f1946fbe8300e906c30491387e565f3b58d7f049 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Alex Wang <alexw@nicira.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Mar 2014 10:42:08 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] ovs-rcu: Call ovsrcu_init() in ovsrcu_quiesce().

This commit fixes a bug introduced by 0f2ea848(ovs-rcu: New library.).
It is possible that ovsrcu_quiesce() is called before ovsrcu_init().
So, it is necessary to call ovsrcu_init() in ovsrcu_quiesce().

Signed-off-by: Alex Wang <alexw@nicira.com>
Acked-by: Ben Pfaff <blp@nicira.com>

diff --git a/lib/ovs-rcu.c b/lib/ovs-rcu.c
index ac4513b33..1843ef598 100644
--- a/lib/ovs-rcu.c
+++ b/lib/ovs-rcu.c
@@ -127,6 +127,7 @@ ovsrcu_quiesce_start(void)
 void
 ovsrcu_quiesce(void)
 {
+    ovsrcu_init();
     ovsrcu_perthread_get()->seqno = seq_read(global_seqno);
     seq_change(global_seqno);
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: lib/ovs-rcu.c**
- Added a call to `ovsrcu_init()` at the beginning of the `ovsrcu_quiesce()` function.

### Relationships
The modification addresses a bug where `ovsrcu_quiesce()` could be invoked before `ovsrcu_init()`, potentially leading to undefined behavior. By ensuring that `ovsrcu_init()` is called within `ovsrcu_quiesce()`, the patch guarantees that the necessary initialization occurs before any operations that depend on it, thus maintaining the integrity of the RCU (Read-Copy-Update) mechanism.

Here is the commit message:
ovs-rcu: Call ovsrcu_init() in ovsrcu_quiesce().

This commit fixes a bug introduced by 0f2ea848(ovs-rcu: New library.).
It is possible that ovsrcu_quiesce() is called before ovsrcu_init().
So, it is necessary to call ovsrcu_init() in ovsrcu_quiesce().

Signed-off-by: Alex Wang <alexw@nicira.com>
Acked-by: Ben Pfaff <blp@nicira.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug occurs because `ovsrcu_quiesce()` can be called before `ovsrcu_init()`, which means that the necessary initialization for the RCU mechanism may not have been performed, leading to potential undefined behavior or incorrect state during the quiescing process.

Here is the patch:
  * ovs-rcu.h. */
 void
 ovsrcu_quiesce(void)
 {
+    ovsrcu_init();
     ovsrcu_perthread_get()->seqno = seq_read(global_seqno);
     seq_change(global_seqno);
 
     ovsrcu_quiesced();
 }
